errors.text_span: динамиката на приходите от индустрията за преработка на отпадъци в България
errors.evidence: The figure caption identifies the topic as "Динамика ПЧИ в България" (Dynamics of FDI in Bulgaria), not revenue from the waste processing industry. The machine has likely misinterpreted the title of the paper it was taken from.

errors.text_span: Отново, тече вляво до 2018 и вдясно до 2022.
errors.evidence: This sentence is grammatically awkward and difficult to understand. It seems to be a nonsensical attempt to describe the direction of the x-axis.
The y-axis scale clearly goes up to 5,000,000, not 4,800,000.

The chart clearly displays two data series: a solid line representing a trend, and a scatter plot of individual data points. The description only mentions one line, fundamentally misrepresenting the chart's structure.
The solid line begins at a value of approximately 4,150,000 in 2018. The value 3,800,000 is the minimum value on the y-axis, not the starting point of the data.
There are far more than six markers on the plot; a visual count shows there are approximately 24 markers.
The markers are not located on the line; they are plotted as a scatter plot with points distributed around the trend line.
